note: Each pass default<O1> runs, printed or implicit, is in exactly one family. A family groups passes whose rewrites share proof machinery, so one checked lemma can discharge instances in several passes. Blockers are task IDs in docs/llvm-verification-tasks.md.

peephole-int.title: Local integer and vector rewrites
peephole-int.shared: InstSimplify's folds are called by instcombine, early-cse, sccp, simplifycfg and loop-instsimplify, so a lemma for one fold covers its instances in all of them. InstCombine's combines are reused by vector-combine and reassociate's canonical forms
peephole-int.proof_shape: Each rewrite as a theorem over BitVec of every width, with poison flags, then each instance as an instantiation of it

fp-narrowing.title: Floating point to integer narrowing
fp-narrowing.proof_shape: Floating point semantics, then the range argument float2int makes

redundancy-constprop.title: Redundancy elimination and constant propagation
redundancy-constprop.shared: Replacing a value by an equal one where a dominating definition or a lattice fact says so. sccp and ipsccp share SCCPSolver
redundancy-constprop.proof_shape: A replacement lemma: equal values at a dominated use, from a sound analysis fact

dead-code.title: Dead code and dead global elimination
dead-code.shared: Removing what nothing observes: a value with no use and no effect, a global nothing references
dead-code.proof_shape: A deletion lemma for effect-free values, and module-level semantics for globals and arguments

cfg.title: Control flow simplification
cfg.shared: Block merging, branch folding, select formation and switch lowering, shared through Utils/Local.cpp and SimplifyCFG.cpp
cfg.proof_shape: A simulation between the two block graphs, with select and phi lemmas

memory-promotion.title: Memory to SSA, and memory operation rewriting
memory-promotion.shared: PromoteMemToReg is used by sroa and mem2reg. Alignment facts come from the same known-bits code
memory-promotion.proof_shape: A relation between source and target memories, which allocas disappear from

libcalls.title: Library call semantics
libcalls.shared: Each depends on what a C library function means, from TargetLibraryInfo
libcalls.proof_shape: Contracts for the library functions, then the rewrite against them

loops.title: Loop canonicalization and loop transforms
loops.shared: Every loop adaptor runs loop-simplify and lcssa first. ScalarEvolution and LoopInfo facts are shared by indvars, loop-deletion, unrolling and idiom recognition
loops.proof_shape: Loop simulation and invariants, with ScalarEvolution's facts proved sound

vectorization.title: Vectorization
vectorization.proof_shape: Vector semantics and the loop vectorizer's legality conditions

inlining-ipo.title: Inlining and interprocedural transforms
inlining-ipo.shared: InlineFunction in Utils, and module-level semantics of calls and globals
inlining-ipo.proof_shape: Call semantics with a callee body, then substitution

attribute-inference.title: Attribute and promise inference
attribute-inference.shared: FunctionAttrs.cpp and BuildLibCalls.cpp: memory effects, nounwind, willreturn, mustprogress, noundef, returned
attribute-inference.proof_shape: Each attribute's meaning as UB or a fact, and the inference sound for it. Until then a target with willreturn or mustprogress can't be bound

annotation-noop.title: Annotations, metadata, intrinsic lowering and checks
annotation-noop.shared: Each leaves the model's semantics alone on inputs without its intrinsic, attribute or metadata, or lowers an intrinsic to what it means
annotation-noop.proof_shape: Identity on what the model sees, or the intrinsic's contract

analysis-management.title: Analysis requirements and invalidation
analysis-management.proof_shape: Cached analyses are still true when read: preservation and invalidation are right
